zh: 确认后才会出发；不会改变你的动作。
看一下安排，点“好”才出发。
en: Review the plan and choose OK to start.

zh: 现在没有能接下这单的伙伴，请看每个人的原因。
en: Nobody can take this order right now. Check each reason.

zh: 已接受的伙伴开始执行；接单不等于完成。
en: The selected companions have started. Completion will be reported.

zh: 这次大家的安排都完成了。

en: Let me finish what I am doing.

zh: 按原模型对话处理，不由本地代办。
en: Handled through the original model conversation.

zh: 不在同一区域，不能接这单。
en: In another region; cannot join this order.
Too hungry to join right now.

zh: 目标尚未建好或无法使用。
en: The destination is not available yet.

zh: 已打开原烧烤邀请；仍需你亲自选菜、开烤。
en: The barbecue invitation is open. Choose food and start grilling yourself.

zh: 我没太听明白，能像下面这样说吗？
en: I did not quite catch that. Could you try one of these?

zh: 咦？我没听懂！试试这么说？
en: Huh? I missed that! Try saying it like this?

zh: 这件事我还没听明白，说清楚我再动手。
en: I need a clearer instruction before I get to work.
...I did not understand. You can say this.

zh: 这单做完了，东西都在原处。
en: This job is finished; everything is accounted for.

zh: %s的这单已暂停或被新安排替换，不记为完成。
en: %s’s order paused or was replaced; it is not marked complete.

zh: 大家都跟上了，会继续跟随。
en: Everyone has caught up and will keep following.

zh: 大家已到集合点，会按原规则留一会儿。
en: Everyone has arrived and will stay for the original gathering period.
